## 8. Interpretation

**Validation (in-sample): gross edge may survive realistic costs; proceed to excursion/execution tests. Holdout (out-of-sample): gross edge exists out-of-sample but is below realistic execution costs; no viable path without execution changes (best break-even 6.86 bps/side). Decision: no viable path without execution changes.**

The four winners were selected on validation, so the validation result is in-sample. Only the holdout is out-of-sample evidence.

- Validation best gross-positive break-even: > 30 bps/side (in-sample).
- Holdout best gross-positive break-even: 6.86 bps/side (out-of-sample).

**Validation rationale (in-sample):** At least one config has positive gross expectancy in-sample with a best break-even of 10 bps per side or higher (or still positive at 30 bps). This warrants the excursion and execution experiments before drawing any profitability conclusion.

**Holdout rationale (out-of-sample):** At least one config has positive gross expectancy out-of-sample, but the best break-even is below 10 bps per side. Without execution changes this is unlikely to produce a viable net edge.
